environments.rationale: shared CI is suitable for bounded smoke budgets but too noisy to claim tight relative performance superiority

targets.workload_description: Deterministic in-process projection of one prevalidated tenant/environment context envelope; execution is intentionally deferred until E9-PILOT-001C implements the runtime.
targets.rationale: Register the runtime budget at boundary creation time without fabricating a measurement before implementation. A 1 ms shared-CI p95 ceiling is a deliberately coarse safety budget for a pure deterministic standard-library projection; E9-C must make the workload executable before enabling PR performance execution.
